Nina (sales): Quick sync00Client: Helios Labs POC. They want Private deployment. Key asks: preserve client IPs, minimal firewall surface, avoid hairpin through internet (SD-WAN split tunnel), and ask whether PrivateLink or peering is better for a short 6-week POC.
Ethan (netops): Short answer: if they can renumber, peering/TGW preserves IPs and is straightforward. If their VPC CIDR overlaps ours, PrivateLink works without renumbering but hides client IPs.
Carmen (solutions): If they need client IPs in SIEM and cannot change apps, peering is recommended. PrivateLink option: have their side add X-Forwarded-For at the edge or run an NLB+proxy in their account to forward original IPs. Adds ops work.
Vik (eng): Also possible: accept endpoint ENI IPs and join logs on session IDs rather than raw client IPs, but that depends on their SIEM use cases.
Nina (sales): Pricing question: Helios expects ~200GB/month during POC. Any rough numbers?
Ethan (netops): PrivateLink has endpoint-hour + per-GB. For small POC volumes it's often cheaper (low fixed cost). Peering has no per-GB AWS fee for same-region peering; TGW has attachment costs. We'll give a short estimate for their region.
Carmen (solutions): Firewall/Security group checklist (minimal):
```
- Customer SG: allow outbound TCP 443 to our service CIDR
- Redwood SG: allow inbound TCP 443 from customer CIDR
- DNS to their resolver (UDP/TCP 53)
- Optional: healthcheck TCP 8000 between subnets over peering
```
Ethan (netops): If overlap exists: suggest using PrivateLink or ask customer about short-term renumbering. We can also suggest a NAT instance, but that adds latency and complexity.
Nina (sales): Timeline: can we do network cutover + smoke test in 10 business days after they hand off CIDRs and VPN info?
Ethan (netops): Yes for PrivateLink or peering (if no overlap). If overlap, PrivateLink is fastest.
ops-bot: Created ticket NETOPS-4810 (Helios Labs POC network)
Nina (sales): Action items: Ethan - SG snippets and cost ballpark for 200GB; Carmen - one-pager for Helios SecOps about source-IP tradeoffs and TLS inspection notes; Vik - comment on any app changes needed for X-Forwarded-For. I'll send customer the next steps.
